name: Superconduct Blessing: Deep Freeze
description:
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Cryo Dice and 2 Electro Dice.
After your opponent is affected by Physical DMG or Cryo DMG: Attach Untunable and Cost Increase to 1 random card in the opponent's Hand. (Twice per Round)
